verdict.rationale:
Docs describe explicit per-agent spend caps (max spend amount, allowed counterparties, time window) enforced onchain for wallets, and scoped fixed-allowance order intents for agent cards, both described as revocable at any time by the user (crossmint-supp-4, crossmint-supp-2, crossmint-docs-13). This directly matches the story of setting spend caps/usage limits and instant revocation of agent payment authority.
missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of instant revocation actually working in practice, and confirmation that revocation is truly instantaneous rather than eventual (e.g., on next transaction check).
